summary: Atlantic Union Bankshares Corp filed an 8-K to announce a quarterly earnings conference call and webcast for its second quarter 2026 financial results on July 21, 2026. This is a routine disclosure of an upcoming earnings event, not a special situation. The filing includes Items 8.01 (Other Events) and 9.01 (Financial Statements and Exhibits), with a press release as Exhibit 99.1. No deal terms, activist activity, strategic review, restructuring, or capital return are involved. The filing is purely informational and administrative, lacking any corporate action meeting the special-situations criteria.
